faq.title: FAQ
faq.generalQ1: How often is the dashboard data updated?
faq.generalA1: Core revenue, loan, and deposit data is batch-updated daily at 04:00. FX rates and system health are monitored in real time and refresh every 5 minutes.
faq.generalQ2: How do I add or remove branches from monitoring?
faq.generalA2: Go to Settings > Branch Management and check the branches you want to monitor. Changes take effect on your next login.
faq.generalQ3: Can I export reports for presentations?
faq.generalA3: Yes. Click 'Export Report' in the top right corner. PDF, Excel, and CSV formats are supported, with customizable date ranges and metrics.
faq.transactionQ1: How do I look up specific transaction details?
faq.transactionA1: Use Quick Search (Cmd+K) and enter the transaction ID, customer name, or amount range. The system will filter relevant records in real time.
faq.transactionQ2: What criteria are used for suspicious transaction alerts?
faq.transactionA2: The system uses a combination of transaction amount deviation (Z-score > 2.5), transaction frequency, cross-border characteristics, and blacklist matching.
faq.transactionQ3: How do I handle false positive alerts?
faq.transactionA3: Click the alert in the Fraud Alert Feed, select 'Mark as False Positive,' and provide a reason. The system will learn from this pattern to reduce future false positives.
faq.riskQ1: What metrics does the risk tolerance setting affect?
faq.riskA1: Risk tolerance affects alert thresholds, NPL ratio warning levels, and the risk level filtering for investment product recommendations.
faq.riskQ2: How often are compliance checks performed?
faq.riskA2: KYC and AML checks are continuously monitored. Periodic audits are conducted quarterly, with results displayed in the Compliance Overview card.
faq.riskQ3: How do I set up custom alert rules?
faq.riskA3: Go to Alert Threshold Settings, select the metric to monitor and adjust the threshold. Supported metrics include transaction amount, NPL ratio, NPS, and more.
